name: Paradise Lost/Fake World
original_name: パラダイスロスト/フェイクワールド
source:
When I awoke in my room, I thought with my clouded head.
What time is it now?
The ticking of the clock is annoying.

...What had I been doing, again?
My head hurts. My body feels heavy.
My memories are a mess.

That's right. I was looking for something.
...What was that 'something'?

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/18582]Freem![/url]]
translation:
在自己的房间里醒来时，我用昏沉的脑袋思索着。
现在几点了？
时钟的滴答声令人心烦。

……我之前在做什么来着？
头很疼，身体也沉重得很。
记忆一片混乱。

对了，我在找某样东西。
……那“某样东西”，究竟是什么？

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/18582]Freem![/url]]
